messages:
Ivy (Support): @Tariq escalate please — client Voltix can't finish onboarding because their IdP assertion fails during account provisioning. Trial kickoff is tomorrow and they mentioned a renewal decision tied to a successful demo. They see: 'Assertion consumer URL mismatch'. Account voltix-trial-21.

Tariq (CS Lead): Ugh. Can you confirm whether it's a metadata mismatch or a redirect URL issue? Also does the customer have a fallback we can use (employee invite or API key) so we don't block the demo?

Ivy (Support): Quick paste from logs: 
```
2026-03-24T14:12:02Z ERROR saml-handler account=voltix-trial-21 reason=acs_mismatch expected=https://console.redwood.ai/sso/callback got=https://app.voltix.com/sso/callback
```
They uploaded vendor metadata with the console URL instead of the app URL. They can’t change it without a brief call and they’re on a tight timeline.

Zoe (SRE): From infra side we can issue a temporary provisioning bypass for this trial: create a one-time invite link that skips IdP verification or generate a short-lived API key so their demo can run. Tradeoffs: bypass for demo only, audit log flagged, must be revoked after. I can generate if approved.

Owen (Acct Exec): If we miss the demo they may push renewal. Recommend: 1) acknowledge now, 2) offer immediate invite bypass + schedule a 20m setup call, 3) offer a 30-day renewal extension and 10% trial credit if they feel impacted. Need a draft note. I can join the call for contract context.

Mina (CS Ops): Drafting message — propose short, empathetic, and decisive. Please review: 

"Hi Voltix team — thanks for flagging this. We've identified that the IdP metadata uploaded points at your app URL rather than the console callback, which is causing the assertion mismatch. To avoid delaying your demo, we can: (A) generate a one-time invite that bypasses IdP verification so your team can complete the demo now, or (B) issue a short-lived API key for the demo. We'll also schedule a 20-minute setup call to correct the metadata and re-enable standard SSO. If you'd like, we can extend your trial window by 30 days and apply a trial credit if this impacted your evaluation. Please let us know which option you prefer and what time works for a quick call. — Mina (Redwood)"

Tariq (CS Lead): Good. Send it and include the caveat that the bypass will be revoked after the demo. Zoe, please prepare the invite option and hold until customer confirms. Owen, please join the call. Mina, schedule in the earliest slot and include the revocation timeframe.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: Voltix onboarding call — 20m — 2026-03-25 09:00 CET — attendees: Mina, Owen, Zoe — meeting link: https://meet.redwood.ai/voltix-setup

Ivy (Support): Message sent; customer replied: "Please do the invite bypass and confirm link asap, demo at 09:30 CET works."

Zoe (SRE): Generated one-time invite link: https://app.redwood.ai/invite/oneoff/zt9x — set to expire in 3 hours. I'll flag audit logs and schedule automatic revoke at 12:45 CET.

Tariq (CS Lead): Perfect. After the call, capture timeline, decisions, and include recommended guardrails so we don't create bypass as a default. Assign postmortem: Zoe (infra RCA) + Mina (customer summary + credit rec). Owen will own renewal outreach if needed. Closing after call. :white_check_mark:
